goal: Move private protocol-related helper methods out of Safelist into a new package-private helper class to reduce the size and responsibilities of Safelist while keeping API intact.

ops.details: Create a new top-level package-private utility class SafelistHelper in org.jsoup.safety and implement the three helper routines previously private inside Safelist: getProtocolValue(Element el, Attribute attr), isSafeProtocol(String value, Set<Safelist.Protocol> protocols), and isValidAnchor(String value). Preserve original logic exactly. Remove these private methods from Safelist and replace their usages with calls to SafelistHelper.getProtocolValue(...), SafelistHelper.isSafeProtocol(...), and SafelistHelper.isValidAnchor(...).

Move the three private methods (getProtocolValue, isSafeProtocol, isValidAnchor) into SafelistHelper as package-private static methods. Update their references to use Normalizer.lowerCase (fully qualified or via existing imports) and keep types identical; for isSafeProtocol method parameter, use Set<Safelist.Protocol> so existing references compile without additional changes.

Add required imports in SafelistHelper: import org.jsoup.nodes.Element; import org.jsoup.nodes.Attribute; import java.util.Set; import static org.jsoup.internal.Normalizer.lowerCase; and package declaration 'package org.jsoup.safety;'.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
